badge: The judge preferred Crystal Balls in 18 country-weeks, the plain forecast in 8, and called 6 even.
sentence: The judge is a model reading in words, not a score. Every forecast and every verdict is in the repository, timestamped before the week began.
note: The first judged country-weeks are a test on stored headlines: the 2026-10-24 forecasts were judged against the week of 2026-11-01.
